title: Bram and the Lantern
author: Casper Galloway
blurb: Casper Okonkwo, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
